description: Enhanced boundary coverage for project reference resolution: the current project contributes its own local table in addition to a view that depends on an object supplied by an external referenced project, confirming only current-project objects are reported.

sql_files.LocalTbl.sql:
CREATE TABLE [dbo].[LocalTbl]
(
	c1 int NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY
)
sql_files.View1.sql:
-- references Table1 from the referenced project
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[View1]
  AS SELECT * FROM [Table1]

sql_files.Table1.sql:
CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Table1]
(
	c1 int NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
	c2 int NULL
)

cases.expected_output:
exit_code=0
package_exists=true
tables=[dbo].[LocalTbl]
views=[dbo].[View1]
pre_deploy_script=false
post_deploy_script=false
diagnostics=none
